content:
The option "Edit as New Message" is only available when a user right-clicks on the body of an email.

There are other ways to do that. In the main Thunderbird window select the folder with the message in the folder pane. Select the message in the message pane. Press Alt or F10 to bring up the menu bar in case it is hidden. From the main menu bar: Message - Edit As New Message

Another way: Right-click the message in the message pane. From the drop-down menu select "Edit As New Message"

The option is also not available in the right-click menu on an email in a mailbox list.

It is, see above.

And yet another way: In the message window with the message open, select Message from the menu bar - Edit As New Message
